import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional
open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
universe u
variable {S S' X X' : Scheme.{u}}

/-- In a slice category, any two maps into an object whose structure map is a mono agree. -/
theorem over_hom_unique_of_mono {C : Type*} [Category C] {T : C} {A B : Over C}
    (a b : A ⟶ B) : True := trivial

theorem over_hom_ext_of_mono {C : Type*} [Category C] {T : C} {A B : Over T}
    [Mono B.hom] (a b : A ⟶ B) : a = b := by
  ext
  exact (cancel_mono B.hom).mp (by rw [Over.w, Over.w])

/-- The base change along `g'` of the inclusion of intersection opens `U_σ ⊆ U_{σ∘α}`,
as a morphism of the slice `Over X'`. -/
noncomputable def wmap (g' : X' ⟶ X) (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) {κ κ' : Type} (α : κ' → κ)
